dependency_notation: fN = coordinate N; other names are public config fields or public-state fields (history, reduced, ev, built, cand, cand_valid, usage, i)

coordinates.name: belief_H
coordinates.formula: P(theta=H | public history); pw.theta_prior (revealed-type evidence under C) x Bayes updates, rounded 1e-12

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: belief_M
coordinates.formula: P(theta=M | public history)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: belief_F
coordinates.formula: P(theta=F | public history)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: belief_X
coordinates.formula: P(theta=X | public history)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: p_probe_resolves
coordinates.formula: bH (IDENTICAL to belief_H): P(a probe now yields a correct candidate)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: p_probe_false_solved
coordinates.formula: (1 - bH)(1 - q): joint P(theta != H and probe reports 'solved')

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: p_H_given_solved
coordinates.formula: bH / (bH + (1-bH)(1-q)); 0 when bH = 0 and q = 1 (undefined -> 0)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: p_b1_resolves
coordinates.formula: bH + bM + bF * [reduced]: P(b1 now returns 'solved')

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: exp_side_cost_rel
coordinates.formula: D_side (1 - bH) / R: expected side-effect charge of a probe now

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: exp_hard_cost_rel
coordinates.formula: t_hard c_b2 (bF + bX) / R: expected T surcharge of an exact call now (0 whenever T is off: every b6/b6c pool)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: event_hazard_active
coordinates.formula: p_event if no event yet in this query else 0: P(an event follows the next non-terminal action)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: cost_exact_b2_rel
coordinates.formula: (c_b2 + hard)(1 + hazard) / R: b2 then commit, one re-run if an event invalidates (re-runs even on X)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: cost_probe_first_rel
coordinates.formula: c_probe + side + q(1-bH) b2_route + (1-bH)(1-q) L + hazard c_probe, / R (forgone reward R on a false 'solved' NOT counted)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: cost_b1_first_rel
coordinates.formula: c_b1 + hard + (1 - p_b1) b2_route, / R (no event re-run term, unlike b2/probe)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: cost_use_rel
coordinates.formula: (C_build / max(k - i, 1) if not built else 0) + c_use, / R: build now, amortized over the remaining queries

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: best_strategy_cost_rel
coordinates.formula: min(b2, probe, b1, use) / R == min(f11..f14) (clip is monotone)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: build_value_rel
coordinates.formula: (rem (min(b2, probe, b1) - c_use) - C_build) / R if not built else 0; rem = max(k - i, 1)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: remaining_queries_rel
coordinates.formula: max(k - i, 1) / 8 (also a function of the public vector k/8 and the qfrac input)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: built
coordinates.formula: structure built

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: candidate_valid
coordinates.formula: a candidate exists and no event invalidated it

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: candidate_exact
coordinates.formula: valid candidate from b1 / b2 / use (always correct on commit)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: candidate_trust
coordinates.formula: 1 if exact; p_H_given_solved if probe candidate; else 0.  Under U (q < 1) this applies the probe likelihood a SECOND time (belief already conditions on 'solved'): trust > P(commit correct) = bH

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction

coordinates.name: steps_left_rel
coordinates.formula: remaining deadline budget of the query (constant 1 in every b6/b6c pool: D never on)

arms.SUP: supplied input (exact) to the fusion layer only (not the GRU)
arms.LRN: target only; policy reads stop-gradient prediction
